notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 96–420, § 2, Oct. 10, 1980, 94 Stat. 1785, which set out Congressional findings and declaration of policy, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
Short TitlePub. L. 96–420, § 1, Oct. 10, 1980, 94 Stat. 1785, provided that Pub. L. 96–420, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Maine Indian Claims Settlement Act of 1980”.
